title: rmrodell/nanomodamp pipeline - params.input schema
description: Sample sheet contract (plan §5.1). Columns other than the four below are metadata and are carried into the merged counts.

sample_id.errorMessage: sample_id must be provided and may contain only letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'

fastq.errorMessage: fastq must be a .fastq.gz file or a directory of .fastq.gz files (no spaces). Relative paths are resolved against the sample sheet's directory.

rep.errorMessage: rep (batch-paired replicate, D17) must be provided and cannot contain spaces
